fullPassage:
Best Soccer Leagues in the World

English Premier League - England
The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are considered the "Big 6." This league's players compete at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.

La Liga - Spain
Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous for its highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively. Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic."

Bundesliga - Germany
Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat. While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and well organized strategies.

❌ ③ surrender: 항복하다 — 유사 뉘앙스 (포기)
❌ ④ recede: 물러나다 — 동의어
det.tip: retreat(후퇴하다) ↔ advance(전진하다) — 축구에서 retreat은 수비 복귀를 의미

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 rose가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② gained status — came up: (A)는 중요한 위치로 올랐다는 뜻이고 (B)는 해가 떠올랐다는 뜻
❌ ① came up — gained status: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ gained status — expanded: (B)는 '확장'이 아닌 '떠오름'
❌ ④ increased — gained status: (A)는 단순 증가가 아닌 지위 상승
det.tip: rose: 다의어. 지위/명성이 올라가다 vs 해/물건이 떠오르다

questions.stem:

"a person or team that competes against another for the same goal"

det.analysis:
✅ ④ rival: 같은 목표를 두고 경쟁하는 사람/팀
❌ ① colleague: 동료 — 경쟁 관계가 아님
❌ ② spectator: 관중 — 경쟁하는 당사자가 아님

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of __________. (important) Among the 20 teams, six are considered the "Big 6."
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ importance: 'position of + 명사' 구조이므로 형용사 important를 명사 importance로 변환
오답 불가: important(형용사 원형), importantly(부사) 등은 문법적으로 부적합
det.tip: important(형용사) → importance(명사). 'a position of + 명사' 구조 기억

questions.passage: While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and well __________ strategies. (organize) The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ organized: 'well + 과거분사' 구조이므로 organize를 organized로 변환
오답 불가: organizing(현재분사), organization(명사) 등은 'well ____ strategies' 구조에 부적합
det.tip: well + p.p.(과거분사): well organized, well known, well established

questions.passage:
Best Soccer Leagues in the World

English Premier League - England
The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are considered the "Big 6." This league's players compete at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.

La Liga - Spain
Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous for its highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively. Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic."

Bundesliga - Germany
Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team ____ the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat. While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and well organized strategies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: loses control of — 공의 통제를 잃으면 빠르게 공격한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① loses control of: gegenpressing은 볼 점유를 잃었을 때 즉시 압박하는 전술
❌ ② gains possession of: 점유를 얻으면 공격하는 것은 일반적 상황이지 gegenpressing이 아님
❌ ③ passes control of: 통제를 넘기다는 자발적 행위로 맥락 부적합
❌ ④ maintains hold on: 유지하면 공격이 아닌 점유 유지
det.tip: lose control of = 통제를 잃다. gegenpressing은 볼 로스트 후 즉시 역압박
